changes: R01 produces one actual unloaded E01 weapon with E02 capacity 30; stock quantities, output UI and storage mass preserve ownership and physical capacity.
Normal panels request current information only for their visible purpose; the whole-model snapshot remains available for diagnostics.
Live navigation presents on a reserved frame; no elapsed game time is discarded and consecutive navigation cannot starve simulation pumps.
Battlefield markers expose fresh permitted marker facts without exporting goods/claims/events; inspector labels are assembled once before assignment.
Walking ammunition validation uses one fresh synchronous batch; vehicle readiness retains original eligibility while omitting unused recursive load mass.
A single low-priority, semaphore-woken console consumer writes immutable report text outside the game thread; queued text is drained and the worker joined on logger shutdown.
Optional current/previous-frame inclusive scope history diagnoses outliers; it does not replace the fixed monotonic gate.

design_justification.principle: Narrow read models and information boundaries
design_justification.evidence: Work initially failed at 67.299 ms, Army Supply at 63.44 ms and Dispatch at 34.165 ms. Removed discarded graph/detail reads; preserve live authoritative command validation.
Movement batch and marker results exist only within synchronous reads; visibility/order/position and legacy read parity guards verify that mutations remain immediately visible.

design_justification.principle: Keep blocking I/O off the interactive thread
design_justification.evidence: logs/prototype-native-popup-menus records a 29.363 ms failed frame; frame_scopes attributes 28.879 ms to the old console drain. Its cooperative loop could not interrupt a native write.
Console worker owns only text I/O; Mutex guards queue handoff, Semaphore avoids polling, no scene/ledger/counter access occurs on the worker, shutdown posts then joins.
Frame/action/call/progress ceilings were retained. Menu acceptance checks the same continuing model, 1x progress, time debt and AI age rather than accepting smooth but stalled simulation.

regression_checks.result: Updated real logistics launcher: eleven cases passed, no failures/errors/skips. Component stepping is not ordinary full-loop or FPS evidence.
